ui.status.wakeup.rebind: no kernel patch; falling back to UDC rebinding
ui.status.wakeup.none: unsupported by kernel; signal mode degrades
ui.hint.key: : sends a key report only. Best for sleep, a locked screen or a blanked display; the target must have "Allow this device to wake the computer" enabled in its BIOS or device manager.
ui.hint.signal: : sends a wake signal without producing any keystroke.
ui.hint.both: : signal first, then the key. Highest chance of success.
startup.bad_mode: WAKE_MODE must be one of key, signal or both (got {value}).
err.payload: The request body must be a JSON object.
err.csrf: CSRF check failed. Refresh the page and try again.
err.repeat.number: The repeat count must be a number
err.repeat.range: The repeat count must be between 1 and 5
err.device.missing: {device} does not exist; the gadget is not ready
err.device.disabled: HID device unusable ({error}); the gadget was disabled by the host
err.device.write: Failed to write to the HID device: {error}
err.report.length: Failed to write to the HID device: short write
err.bus.suspended: The bus is suspended, so the target is probably asleep. The report is queued and will be delivered once the host resumes.
warn.no_wakeup_patch: The kernel has no f_hid wakeup_on_write patch, so no real remote wakeup signal can be sent; only an empty report was sent. The target may not wake up while it is off or hibernating.
warn.release_blocked: The press report was queued, but the host never collected the release, so the target is very likely asleep. The key may still be held down after wake — click once more to reset it.
warn.press_blocked: The HID queue still holds a report the host has not collected (the target is very likely asleep), so this key press could not be queued.
